claims: Tyler Reddick won the 2026 Goodyear 400 at Darlington Raceway on March 22, 2026.
Tyler Reddick overcame early battery issues.
Tyler Reddick secured his fourth victory of the season for 23XI Racing.
Tyler Reddick beat Brad Keselowski by over 5 seconds.
Tyler Reddick drives the No. 45 23XI Racing Toyota.
Tyler Reddick lost the lead in Stage 1.
Tyler Reddick had a lack of a cooling suit.
Tyler Reddick led the final 30 laps.
Darlington Raceway is "Too Tough to Tame".
The Goodyear 400 was held in March.
The Cook Out Southern 500 is the other major Cup Series event at Darlington.
The Goodyear 400 at Darlington Raceway on March 22, 2026 was a NASCAR Cup Series race.
